subject: general
question: A man covered a distance of 245 km in 7 hours on a scooter. How much distance (in km) can be covered on a electric cycle in 4 hours, if he rides the electric cycle at 3/7 of the speed of the scooter?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Speed of the **scooter** = 245 ÷ 7 = 35 kmph.

Speed of the **electric cycle** = 3/7 × 35 = 15 kmph.

**Distance** covered by the **electric cycle** in 4 hours = 15 × 4 = 60 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 60 km.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Distance** covered by **scooter** = 245 km

**Time** taken by **scooter** = 7 hr

**Speed** ratio of **electric cycle** to **scooter** = 3 : 7

**Time** taken by **electric cycle** = 4 hr

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edcadbb67761da4fb69a89e57a67752cda19401402be143971e77e59f2a03b46.png] 

⇒ Speed of the **scooter** = 245 ÷ 7 = 35 kmph

⇒ Speed of the **electric cycle** = (3/7) × 35 = 15 kmph

⇒ **Distance** covered by the **electric cycle** = Speed × Time

⇒ **Distance** = 15 × 4 = 60 km

**∴ The correct answer is 60 km.**

**__Additional Information__**

Basic Speed Formula

Speed is defined as the rate of change of distance with respect to time. Formula: Speed = Distance ÷ Time.

Proportionality of Distance

When the time is constant, the distance covered is directly proportional to the speed (D ∝ S).

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from kmph to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to kmph, multiply by 18/5.</p
